title: Relay announces Vaults retirement and withdrawal-interface deadline
description: Relay stated that its Vaults yield service was being retired, new deposits were no longer accepted, and users should withdraw from relay.link/vaults. The withdrawal interface is planned to close December 31, 2026; users can still withdraw directly from contracts afterward.
notes: Do not interpret as complete shutdown of Relay's cross-chain services or permanent inaccessibility after December 31.

title: Blur announces November 12 cutoff for new Blend loan matching
description: Blur announced on October 12 that Blend will stop matching new NFT-backed loans on November 12, 2026. Borrowers can repay or default, and a withdrawal tool is planned afterward. No completed lending-service shutdown is asserted on the announcement date.
notes: A future effective-status change requires follow-up; Blur NFT marketplace frontend is separately tracked by MAG.

title: Yield Yak core contributor proposes orderly protocol sunset
description: A Yield Yak core contributor proposed a conditional sunset process, with vaults potentially moving to withdrawal-only, a YAK treasury distribution in two stages, and frontend support through at least Q2 2027. The official statement says normal operations continue while questions, discussion and a Snapshot vote are pending.
notes: This is a governance proposal, not a successful vote or completed service termination.
